headline: Arquivo Fantasma Project Gives Forgotten Digital Fragments a Voice with Open-Weight AI
summary: This innovative open-weight AI project aims to preserve digital history by giving a voice to forgotten fragments of data, ensuring they are not lost to time.
details: Arquivo Fantasma, meaning 'Ghost Archive', is a new project focused on preserving digital fragments that might otherwise be lost. It utilizes open-weight AI models to give these forgotten pieces of data a voice and a chance at being remembered.

The project's core mission is to combat digital amnesia by creating a system that can interpret and present fragmented digital information in a meaningful way. This approach ensures that even obscure or incomplete data can contribute to our understanding of digital history.

By leveraging open-weight AI, Arquivo Fantasma democratizes access to advanced AI capabilities for digital preservation. This allows for greater community involvement and innovation in how we approach the challenge of archiving the ever-growing digital world.

The developers have highlighted that the service is written in Rust, a programming language known for its performance and reliability. This choice suggests a commitment to building a robust and efficient system for handling complex data processing tasks.

topic: us president to ban term artificial intelligence
headline_marked: [[Trump Bans 'AI']] in official documents, prefers 'Super Intelligence'
headline: Trump Bans 'AI' in official documents, prefers 'Super Intelligence'
summary: The former president stated his intention to ban the term 'artificial intelligence' in all official documents, advocating for 'Super Intelligence' (SI) as the preferred nomenclature.
details: President Trump announced his intention to ban the term 'artificial intelligence' (AI) from all official documents, stating it is "a very bad and inaccurate name."
He prefers the term 'Super Intelligence' (SI), which he claims is the name "virtually everyone else is using, or soon will be."
Trump signed an executive order in September directing the executive branch to use SI instead of AI. He previously stated that anyone using 'AI' instead of 'SI' is 'THE ENEMY!'
At the United Nations General Assembly, he told the group that the U.S. would be renaming AI to SI in documents, arguing that 'artificial' makes intelligence sound 'fake'.
Earlier this month, Trump announced the creation of the 'Super Intelligence Force,' tasked with coordinating the federal government's efforts to ensure America leads the world in SI.
caption:
